replacements.reason: The hunt pack placed a second Endaraen at Jethrics Outpost. Both the start and return for Smash the Coral Golems are at 32.5 S, 51.9 E. The captured NPC with the same hunt definition is within 5 m of that location.

replacements.reason: The guide places the Explorer beside Kehan's northwest Ringway. Its historical Ringway coordinate is 42.9 N, 11.5 E; the installed quest text places it at 44.2 N, 11.3 E. Keep the observed Explorer at 44.0 N, 11.3 E next to the working Ringway from the same snapshot.

replacements.name: Naokim
replacements.reason: The single Shadow Antechamber contact appears twice in one capture, as Naokim and its PostATL variant, 1.6 m apart. They use the same actor model and AC2E topics. Use the base contact in this room; keep both native definitions in the catalog.
